name: Être une femme dans les années 60 : la grande expérience
original_name: Être une femme dans les années 60 : la grande expérience
overview: To discover the daily life of a woman in the early 1960s, a modern woman and her family are about to embark on a remarkable experience: they will travel back in time and live for several days with her husband and two children in a place frozen in the 1960s. Using never-before-seen archival footage, she will have to transform herself into the "perfect" wife of the era. How will she and her family react when they discover that a woman of that time was expected to stay home cooking, cleaning, and washing for her entire family? That she had to be prepared to do anything to always remain beautiful and slim? That she couldn't dress as she pleased? And above all, that a woman of that time owed obedience to her husband... in every circumstance! One thing is certain: this leap 60 years into the past will plunge this woman and her family into a completely different world.
